text:
</sub>  Omit per-category records from sweep-off runs

This output contract applies the per-category pass record to every run, including the sweep-off arm, but AC1 only assigns that record to an enabled sweep and AC18 requires an ordinary disabled run to have no per-category result. An implementation following this line would either fabricate `produced_none` outcomes for categories it never considered or classify findings despite the sweep being disabled, corrupting the control evidence. Require `SweepPassRecord` only for sweep-on runs and test its absence for sweep-off output.
